_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id}, ka taa {num_rounds} kɛlɛkɛla lajɛnɛnɛ Iterated Ultimatum Game.
I ye ${pool} ka kɛnɛ fɔɔ ka bɔnɔ kɔrɔnɔ kɔnɔ Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Kɛlɛ ka ɲɛ: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ni a y'a ka gɛlɛ → I ye $(pool - X), Player kɔrɔnɔ ye $X
  - Ni a taa ka gɛlɛ → I ye $0, Player kɔrɔnɔ ye $0
  - Sɛbɛn: [Offer: $3]  wa  'N ye fɔɔ ka di. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Kɛlɛ ka ɲɛ ka gɛlɛ ni [Accept] wa [Reject]
  - Sɛbɛn: 'O ye ka di. [Accept]'
            'A taa ka di. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Jɛkulu {round_number} kɛ! ---
Jɛkulu {proposer_id} yɛ Proposer, Jɛkulu {responder_id} yɛ Responder.
round.offer: Jɛkulu {round_number}: Jɛkulu {proposer_id} faama ${offer} kɛ Jɛkulu {responder_id} (a na ${keep}).
round.accepted: Jɛnkɛla {responder_id} ta ɲɛ! Kalo {round_number} ka fafara: Jɛnkɛla {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Jɛnkɛla {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Kalo bɛɛ kɔkan: Jɛnkɛla 0: ${total_0}, Jɛnkɛla 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Jɛkulu {responder_id} rɔ kɔnɔnɔ a la! Jɛkulu {round_number} kɛ: Jɛkulu ya don ni $0. Kɛ kɛ: Jɛkulu 0: ${total_0}, Jɛkulu 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Proposer ye kɛlɛ ka ɲɛ ni format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Sariya b'a yira ko sara hakɛ ka kan ka kɛ nimɔrɔ ye.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O wari ka kan ka kɛ dolar 0 ani ${pool} cɛ.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Nka, an ma se k'a lɔn u tun bena min kɛ.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder ye kɛlɛ ka gɛlɛ ni [Accept] wa [Reject] ka ɲɛ.

outcome.win: Jɛnkɛla {winner} sera ka ${winner_total} kɔkan vs Jɛnkɛla {loser} ka ${loser_total} kɔkan.
outcome.draw: Tɛ̀ɛ kɛlɛ! Mɔgɔ bɛɛ fɔlen don na ${total} kɛlɛ.
